'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**At least 20 [[Chad]]ian [[Chad National Army|soldiers]] are killed in an attack by [[Boko Haram]] militants during a routine patrol near [[Lake Chad]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/chad-army-says-least-20-soldiers-killed-lake-chad-attack-2021-08-05/ (Reuters)]
*[[Tigray War]]
**The [[Tigray Defense Forces]] capture the town and [[UNESCO]] heritage of [[Lalibela]] in the [[Amhara Region]]. [https://nationalpost.com/pmn/news-pmn/tigrayan-forces-take-control-of-ethiopias-lalibela-a-un-world-heritage-site-eyewitnesses (''National Post'')]
*The [[Colombian government]] announces that it has foiled an alleged bomb plot in [[Bogotá]] by [[FARC dissidents]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/colombia-seizes-explosives-says-it-foils-bogota-attack-2021-08-05/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Wildfires in 2021]]
**[[2021 California wildfires]]
***The [[Dixie Fire]] destroys most of [[Greenville, California]], including large portions of its historic downtown area. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/8/5/raging-wildfire-decimates-northern-california-town (Al Jazeera)]
**[[2021 Turkish wildfires]]
***Hundreds of workers and residents are evacuated as a wildfire nears a coal-powered [[power plant]] in [[Muğla Province]]. More than 36,000 people have been evacuated in the [[provinces of Turkey|province]], as [[President of Turkey|President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] declares the [[wildfire]]s to be the worst in Turkey's history. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/turkish-powerplants-main-units-not-damaged-by-wildfires-says-govt-2021-08-05/ (Reuters)]
**[[2021 Greek wildfires]]
***People in [[Athens]] are told to remain indoors due to smoke from wildfires burning on the outskirts of the city. More than 500 firefighters are fighting a wildfire on [[Parnitha|Mount Parnitha]], while the suburb of [[Varympompi]] is evacuated. [https://www.eureporter.co/world/greece/2021/08/05/athenians-told-to-stay-inside-as-wildfires-cloud-city-skies/ (EU Reporter)]
**[[2021 Italy wildfires]]
***Thousands of [[firefighter]]s and [[Aerial firefighting|water-bombing aircraft]] are deployed as [[wildfire]]s continue to spread across [[Italy]] amid an unprecedented [[heat wave]] caused by a [[heat dome]] event over [[southeast Europe]]. Hundreds of people are evacuated on [[Sardinia]] and [[Sicily]], with [[List of presidents of Sardinia|Sardinian President]] [[Christian Solinas]] describing the situation as an "unprecedented disaster." [https://www.voanews.com/europe/mediterranean-wildfires-rage-italy-counts-environmental-losses (Voice of America)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Japan]] reports a record 15,263 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, including a record 5,042 cases in [[Tokyo]], thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 987,163. [https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20210805_38/ (NHK World-Japan)] [https://apnews.com/article/2020-tokyo-olympics-lifestyle-sports-coronavirus-pandemic-business-0b250f40128b0892863bc55067a4ba39 (Associated Press)]
****The [[Government of Japan|Japanese government]] announces the expansion of the quasi-[[state of emergency]] to eight [[Prefectures of Japan|prefecture]]s from August 8 to August 31. [https://mainichi.jp/english/articles/20210805/p2g/00m/0na/037000c (''The Mainichi'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kazakhstan]]
****[[Kazakhstan]] reports a record 7,792 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 610,744 [https://www.inform.kz/en/kazakhstan-reports-7-792-fresh-daily-covid-19-cases_a3820197 (Kazinform)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Malaysia]]
*****The [[Malaysia]]n [[Ministry of Health (Malaysia)|Ministry of Health]] grants a conditional approval for the [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine]] for emergency use. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-covid-19-moderna-vaccine-conditional-approval-2093997 (CNA)]
****Malaysia reports a record for the second consecutive day of 20,596 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1.2 million.  [https://www.malaymail.com/amp/news/malaysia/2021/08/05/malaysia-notches-another-record-high-with-20596-new-covid-19-cases-today/1995481 (''Malay Mail'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 20,920 new cases of COVID-19, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 693,305. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/2160411/20-920-new-covid-cases-160-new-fatalities (''Bangkok Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Uzbekistan]]
****[[Uzbekistan]] reports a record 951 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 133,852. [https://m.akipress.com/news:661211:Uzbekistan_reports_951_new_daily_cases_of_coronavirus,_9_deaths/ (AKIpress News Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Finland]]
****[[Finland]] restricts the operating hours in [[Southwest Finland]], [[Pirkanmaa]], [[Kymenlaakso]], and the [[Helsinki metropolitan area]] to until 10 p.m. for bars and until 11 p.m. for restaurants and also bans karaoke and indoor dancing beginning on August 8 due to the worsening situation in those regions. The [[Government of Finland|government]] also announces that [[COVID-19 vaccination in Finland|vaccination]] of children between the ages of 12 and 15 will begin next week. [https://yle.fi/uutiset/osasto/news/government_opens_vaccinations_for_12-15-year-olds_gives_green_light_to_covid_pass/12048911 (Yle)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****The [[Italy|Italian]] [[Government of Italy|government]] announces that the usage of a "''Green Pass''" will be mandatory for teachers and university students to enter educational institutions and will also be mandatory for use in long-haul air, rail, ferry, and intercity bus services beginning on September 1. [https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/italy-makes-covid-19-health-pass-mandatory-for-teachers/46846656 (Swissinfo)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Quebec]]
****The province of [[Quebec]] announces that it will implement [[Vaccine passports during the COVID-19 pandemic|vaccine passport]]s. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/montreal/quebec-vaccine-passport-1.6130699 (CBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***The state of [[Victoria (Australia)|Victoria]] enters a [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] for the sixth time since the beginning of the pandemic, joining [[New South Wales]] and [[Queensland]], after a currently unexplained increase in the number of COVID-19 cases. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-08-05/victoria-covid-19-lockdown-restrictions-tightened/100352444 (ABC News Australia)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Chile]]
***The [[Chile]]an [[Government of Chile|government]] announces that they will begin administering booster doses for those who have received the [[Sinovac]] [[CoronaVac]] vaccine beginning on August 11 for people over the age of 55 using the [[Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford-AstraZeneca vaccine]] and in September for people under the age of 55 using the [[Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|Pfizer-BioNTech vaccine]] in order to protect the population from the [[SARS-CoV-2 Delta variant|Delta variant]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-08-05/chile-rolls-out-covid-19-booster-campaign-that-mixes-vaccines (Bloomberg News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Morocco]]
***[[Morocco]] reports a record 12,039 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 665,235. [https://www.moroccoworldnews.com/2021/08/343777/covid-19-morocco-registers-12-039-cases (Morocco World News)]
**[[International aid related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
***[[Spain]] donates 7.5 million vaccines to Latin American countries, with the first countries to receive these vaccines being [[Peru]], [[Paraguay]] and [[Guatemala]]. [https://www.plenglish.com/index.php?o=rn&id=70287&SEO=spain-begins-donation-of-vaccines-to-latin-america (''Prensa Latina'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in France]]
**The [[France|French]] [[Constitutional Council (France)|Constitutional Council]] approves most of the controversial measures that would begin on August 9 which include requiring [[Immunity passport|health passes]] to enter restaurants, cafés, some shopping centres, and use some types of public transportation. The council also approves the vaccine mandate for healthcare workers and other health professionals, in which they must present proof that they have received at least one dose of the [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] beginning on September 15 and must present proof of full vaccination beginning on October 15. However, judges considered the mandatory 10-day [[quarantine]] to be a violation of aspects of French liberties. [https://www.euronews.com/2021/08/05/french-move-to-require-a-covid-pass-to-access-restaurants-is-approved-by-constitutional-co (Euronews)]
*[[Protests over responses to the COVID-19 pandemic]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines]]
**[[List of prime ministers of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines|Prime Minister of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines]] [[Ralph Gonsalves]] is injured during protests against changes to the Public Health Act, which includes [[COVID-19 vaccination|mandatory vaccination against COVID-19]] for [[public sector]] workers and those in "frontline jobs". The Prime Minister received treatment for a head wound. [https://www.caribbeannationalweekly.com/caribbean-breaking-news-featured/st-vincent-prime-minister-injured-during-vaccine-protest/ (Caribbean National Weekly)]
*[[2020 Hong Kong national security law|Hong Kong national security law]]
**LGBT organizations and [[Amnesty International]] ask [[Hong Kong]] to release detained activist [[Jimmy Sham]], who has been repeatedly denied bail since his arrest in February. Amnesty says that Sham has been held in prison "simply for speaking out for his community and LGBTQIA+ rights in Hong Kong." These organizations also warned of Sham's upcoming trial along with 46 others where he could face many more years in prison for "subversion." [https://www.starobserver.com.au/news/out-gay-hong-kong-pro-democracy-activist-faces/204938 (''Star Observer'')]
*[[2021 Ghana gay arrests]]
**A court in Ghana drops a case against 21 LGBT activists who were arrested in May. The 16 women and five men were arrested at a hotel in the [[Volta Region]] for an alleged unlawful assembly, of which the court said that there was not enough evidence to prove the charges. The other charges were dismissed, as promoting LGBT rights is not a crime in Ghana. [https://www.reuters.com/article/ghana-lgbt-idUSL8N2PC6MO (Reuters)]
*Six members of a [[Rapid Support Forces|paramilitary force]] in [[Sudan]] are [[Capital punishment in Sudan|sentenced to death]] for their involvement in the killing of six people during a [[2019–2021 Sudanese protests|2019 protest]] in [[El-Obeid]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/8/5/sudan-sentences-paramilitaries-to-death-for-killing-protesters (Al Jazeera)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**President of Mexico [[Andrés Manuel López Obrador]] announces that the country would host talks between the Venezuelan government of [[Nicolás Maduro]] and the opposition. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexico-host-negotiations-between-venezuelan-government-opposition-2021-08-05/ (Reuters)]
*[[2021 Iranian presidential election]]
**Hardline cleric [[Ebrahim Raisi]] is sworn-in as the eighth [[President of Iran]] after being approved by [[Supreme Leader of Iran|Supreme Leader]] [[Ali Khamenei]]. Raisi has promised to end [[United States sanctions against Iran|US sanctions]] and work for the [[Petroleum industry in Iran|vital oil sector of Iran]], which has been affected by the sanctions. [https://www.dw.com/en/iran-ebrahim-raisi-sworn-in-as-president/a-58771047 (Deutsche Welle)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Apple Inc.]] announces that it will begin to continuously scan its [[smartphone]] and tablet devices for [[child sexual abuse]] material (CSAM). Before an image is stored on the [[iCloud]], the new system will search for matches of already known CSAM. The company claims the system has an "extremely high level of accuracy", and will be included in [[iOS]] and [[iPadOS]] updates later this year. [https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-58109748 (BBC News)]
